capex.quote: Commissioned Fluidized Bed dryer with Hot water generator using Biomass fuel, the drying cost reduced from Rs 1.503/kg to Rs 1.280/kg which replaced Flash dryer using coal as fuel.

bull_bear.body:
- Backward integration through proprietary marigold hybrid seed development, reducing dependence on external seed suppliers and enabling higher xanthophyll yields.
- Diversified product portfolio spanning marigold extracts, spice oleoresins, value-added teas, animal nutrition, and crop inputs, mitigating segment-specific risks.
- Established global distribution network via wholly-owned subsidiaries in Europe, Mexico, and North America, providing direct market access and customer relationships.
- In-house R&D capabilities driving process improvements, new product lines, and entry into adjacent high-value segments like personal care and nutraceuticals.
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Customer concentration risk — Customers contributing more than 10% of turnover account for 61.44% of sales, and those owing more than 10% of total receivables represent 65.64% of receivables, exposing the company to significant revenue and credit loss if a major customer defaults or reduces orders.
- Foreign currency risk — With 94.06% of turnover from exports and significant net USD exposure, fluctuations in USD, GBP, SGD, and EURO exchange rates can materially impact profit before tax and cash flows.
- Commodity price risk — Prices of agricultural commodities are subject to fluctuations due to various factors; open sales not balanced by purchase contracts and inventory expose the company to margin volatility.
- Interest rate risk — Exposure to floating interest rate borrowings means changes in market interest rates directly affect interest expense and profit before tax.
- Liquidity risk — Approximately 98% of the company's debt matures in less than one year, creating refinancing risk and potential liquidity pressure if market conditions tighten.
- Credit risk from trade receivables — The company is exposed to credit risk from its operating activities, primarily trade receivables, where counterparty default or deterioration in creditworthiness could lead to financial loss.
- Concentration of manufacturing and operational risk — The company operates a limited number of plants nationally, and any disruption at these facilities could materially impact production and revenue.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: AVT Natural Products operates in the food and feed ingredients segment, manufacturing natural raw materials across five primary categories: marigold extracts for eye care, food coloring, and poultry pigmentation; spice oleoresins and oils for food coloring and flavoring; value-added teas including decaffeinated and instant teas; animal health and nutrition products; and agricultural crop inputs. The Company serves global B2B customers in food, beverage, animal nutrition, and personal care markets, supported by wholly-owned subsidiaries in Europe, Mexico, and North America that handle sales and marketing.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Marigold Extracts:** eye care ingredients, food coloring, poultry pigmentation
- **Spice Oleoresins & Oils:** food coloring, flavoring oleoresins, spice oils
- **Value-Added Teas:** decaffeinated tea, instant tea
- **Animal Health & Nutrition Products:** animal nutrition products
- **Agricultural Crop Inputs:** botanical crop inputs

outlook.body:
- The Company maintains a dividend policy, having declared a final dividend of Rs. 0.40 per share for FY 2024-25 and an interim dividend of Rs. 0.35 per share for FY 2025-26. No other capital allocation philosophy is explicitly stated.
- Renewable power purchase through open access at Tiptur plant consumed 43,04,350 KWh, which is 91% of total energy consumption.
- In Sathy plant, 100% energy consumed through renewable source by wind mill energy of total energy consumption of 8,32,565 KWh.
- Commissioned Fluidized Bed dryer with Hot water generator using Biomass fuel, reducing drying cost from Rs 1.503/kg to Rs 1.280/kg, replacing Flash dryer using coal as fuel.
- Energy conservation projects implemented: VFD for cooling water pumps, Thyristor control for electric heaters, replacement of conventional lamps with LED, replacement of ceiling fans with BLDC fans, and replacement of energy efficient pumps, resulting in annual savings of over 2,42,700 KWh.
- CSR activities undertaken in skilling, water resource enhancement, infrastructure development, health care, education, and rural sports.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The company continues to invest in process improvements and new technologies to reduce costs and improve efficiencies. A Fluidized Bed dryer with Hot water generator using Biomass fuel was commissioned, replacing a Flash dryer using coal as fuel, reducing drying cost from Rs 1.503/kg to Rs 1.280/kg. Energy conservation projects included installing VFDs for cooling water pumps at multiple plants, thyristor control for electric heaters, and replacing conventional equipment with energy-efficient alternatives. Renewable power purchase through open access was implemented at the Tiptur plant, consuming 43,04,350 KWh (91% of total energy consumption), while the Sathy plant achieved 100% renewable energy consumption via wind mill energy. R&D efforts continue in process improvements, marigold hybrid seed development, new product lines, and new business segments including animal nutrition, derma-cosmetic, and nutraceutical divisions. Clinical studies for the derma-cosmetic division have been completed and manufacturing and marketing efforts initiated. Pre-clinical studies for nutraceutical applications have been completed and full-fledged clinical studies initiated with first trials expected to complete by end of this financial year. The company plans to continue expanding seed production of newly introduced hybrids, invest in co-development with strategic partners, and standardize manufacturing of derma-cosmetic ingredients for commercialization.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

deepdive.thesis: AVT Natural Products is an integrated producer of natural food and feed ingredients, leveraging backward integration, proprietary hybrid seed development, and a diversified portfolio of marigold extracts, spice oleoresins, and value-added teas.

open.item: Full fledged clinical studies initiated and the first set of trials are expected to be completed by end of this financial year.
Initiate commercialization of derma-cosmetic ingredients and standardize manufacturing, while completing first set of clinical trials for nutraceutical formulations by end of FY2026.
Evaluate capacity expansion for value-added Tea (Instant Tea) segment to support future growth and significantly scale the business.
The Company has prima facie maintained prescribed cost records as per the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, 2014.
The company will continue to add product lines to its new divisions to expand the product portfolio and market reach.
The clinical studies for the Derma-cosmetic division have been completed and the manufacturing and marketing efforts have been initiated.

The auditor is of the opinion that no material uncertainty exists as on the date of the audit report of the Company's capability of meeting its liabilities existing at the date of balance sheet as and when they fall due within a period of one year from the balance sheet date.
The Company has not incurred cash losses during the financial year covered by our audit and the immediately preceding financial year.
The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or other borrowings or in payment of interest thereon to any lender.
The Company has not accepted any deposits or amounts deemed to be deposits within the meaning of the Act and RBI directives.

The auditor has opined that the Company has, in all material respects, adequate internal financial controls with reference to financial statements and such controls were operating effectively as at 31 March 2026.

The Company has material pending statutory dues under dispute across multiple tax jurisdictions including GST demands of Rs. 1,720.23 Lakhs, sales tax demands, income tax demands, customs duty demands, and a demand on cancellation of MEIS scrip.
Climate variability and adverse weather patterns remain key risks for marigold crop availability and acreage expansion.
Additional tariffs in the US have significantly impacted export realizations and margins, particularly for the Decaffeinated Tea segment.
Continue pre-commercial trials for pipeline marigold hybrids and expand seed production and growing of newly introduced hybrids.
Expand animal health nutrition division presence across US, Latin America, and Southeast Asia through direct operations and strategic partnerships.
The company will work to standardize the manufacturing of the derma cosmetic ingredients and initiate the commercialization of its products.
